metadata.title: Interaction of massive black hole binaries with their stellar environment: III. Scattering of bound stars

notes: No identifiable individual stars are studied. The paper models an anonymous population of stars bound to M1 and predicts a population of hypervelocity stars without catalog names, numeric identifiers, or individually resolved members (e.g., T:p1-b4 and T:p12-b2). Sgr A* is the central massive black hole, not a star, and is not eligible.
